newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Gujral says to puruse same economic policy.
newsitem.headline: India's Gujral says to puruse same economic policy.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral said on Monday his new centre-left government will pursue economic policies outlined in the pathbreaking 1997/98 budget.
"The economic policy on which our budget has been based will remain more or less the same, maybe some minor changes here or there," Gujral told reporters in parliament.
Gujral, a marxist turned social democrat, said the government's aim was to alleviate poverty and uphold social justice.
"We are committed to serve the people below poverty line, to work for social justice," Gujral said.
Gujral earlier said his government will continue and strengthen economic reforms.
"We will continue the economic reforms and strengthen them," he said.
